revision: V4.1.1 (audited): the V4.1 hardening pass plus the 404 render gate. V4.1.1 -- _fetch_evidence runs _get_evidence_text (a plain gl.nondet.web.get) FIRST as a 2xx status gate and returns NO_EVIDENCE on anything else, then calls _render_evidence_text for the prose and falls back to the verified GET body; gl.nondet.web.render exposes no HTTP status, so with render first a 404 or 500 error page read as a document and set evidence_present, which drives _clamp_tier's third corridor -- a dead link could turn a dismissal into a 25% slash. V4.1 -- full prompt-tag isolation (every litigant-controlled prompt field wrapped in its own sanitized tag: <untrusted_evidence_data>, <covenant_terms>, <plaintiff_allegation>, <evidence_source>) and strict telemetry clamping in _clamp_tier: the MALICIOUS_REPORT floor moved from BPS_CRITICAL (7500) down to BPS_ELEVATED (2500) so a report the metric corroborates is never confiscated as a lie, and the negligible band (< 500 bps) floors CRITICAL_BREACH and ELEVATED_RISK to NORMAL with no evidence escape, so a document can never manufacture a breach out of a metric that shows none. Builds on the V4 audited base.
